Q884.reason: In squint diplopia the outer image comes from the deviating eye and is the false image. A is wrong because monocular diplopia persists with one eye covered. C is wrong because fourth nerve palsy shows on looking down. D is wrong because sixth nerve palsy gives a convergent squint.
